svg.title: Apparition Les Paul / MODERN / SELECTOR NECK wiring diagram
svg.desc: Physical component connection diagram. Rear-view pots, lugs down, numbered 3, 2, 1 from left to right. Silver ovals mark ordinary terminations; bronze ovals mark casing solder points; filled dots mark other shared-terminal junctions. Separated crossings do not connect. Pickup wire profiles are shown at each pickup. Toggle and jack terminals are identified by function; verify your hardware.
svg.text: REAR VIEW · LUGS DOWN · 1 = CCW END / 2 = WIPER / 3 = CW END

svg.text: BRONZE = CASING SOLDER. SILVER = TERMINATION. DOT = SHARED TERMINAL. SEPARATED CROSSINGS DO NOT JOIN.
RED: TONE / GREY: GROUND / DARK: SIGNAL / GOLD: SWITCHING / DASHED GOLD: CLOSED SWITCH CONTACT.
Generic hardware outline: verify lug functions, viewing orientation and continuity on the actual parts.
